purpose: Versioned successor protocol only; the frozen A09 inputs remain immutable and no A09 output has been scored.

development_inputs.population_rule: 24 conventional controls derive any baseline bounds; six originals remain separate defect evidence.
development_inputs.baseline_status: fresh 30-page capture complete and completion-audit validated; 267 source action associations explicitly unresolved for this baseline, and mandatory resolved source-pixel mapping is deferred to future J02 candidate evaluation

candidate_protocol.scope: Future J02 candidate outputs only; never recurse through historical A09 stage output and never include reserves by default.
fail_closed: required editor/export/ZIP artifacts with matching hashes
duplicates, missing pages, stale candidates and extraneous reserves fail before measurement

measurement_definitions.safe_rect_metrics: Geometry proxies only; name them safe-rectangle overflow and element-rectangle overlap. They do not measure glyph pixels, rotation, source container boundaries, cleanup or style.
measurement_definitions.ownership_policy: Require explicit source-reviewed owner/action -> fresh candidate region association. Unresolved mapping is reported and cannot pass.
measurement_definitions.font: Final fitted font size is unknown unless the capture surface exposes measured glyph fit; configured element size is retained separately and cannot satisfy a readability floor.
measurement_definitions.dimensions: Source and exported PNG dimensions must match exactly before a candidate is measured.
measurement_definitions.reporting: Report per page, JA/KO/ZH and reviewed style/layout slice; controls and originals remain separate.

future_gate_methods.G5 ownership: Source-reviewed owner/container associations and explicit fresh mapping; unresolved many-to-one mappings block acceptance.
future_gate_methods.G6 cleanup: Later reviewed glyph-mask and source-difference measurement with fixed support/boundary tolerance; unavailable in G0.
future_gate_methods.G7 glyph/layout: Later browser/native-resolution glyph-bounds and visual review; rectangle proxies cannot satisfy it.

approval.approved_by: project coordinator via user-directed G0 closure
approval.decision: Approve the v2 successor protocol and its development-control baseline bounds. Explicitly unresolved development identities remain recorded; future J02 candidate evaluation fails unless every fresh association is resolved by source-pixel review.
